title: CDP & LLDP
description: Discover neighboring devices using Cisco Discovery Protocol and LLDP.
scenario: Discover neighboring devices using Cisco Discovery Protocol and LLDP.

concepts.title: CDP
concepts.body: CDP (Cisco Discovery Protocol) is Cisco-proprietary. It advertises device info to directly connected neighbors.
concepts.code:
SW1# show cdp neighbors
Device ID  Local Intrfce  Platform  Port ID
SW2        Gig 0/1        WS-C2960  Gig 0/1

concepts.title: LLDP
concepts.body: LLDP (IEEE 802.1AB) is the open standard equivalent. Enable it with "lldp run" globally.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# lldp run
SW1# show lldp neighbors

concepts.title: Why Discover?
concepts.body: CDP/LLDP help map the network, verify connections, and troubleshoot. Disable on untrusted ports for security.
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# no cdp enable
SW1(config-if)# no lldp transmit
